final: WITH invoice_groups AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Company, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM InvoiceLine AS il JOIN Invoice AS i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Customer AS c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Company), line_total AS (SELECT SUM(line_count) AS total_count FROM invoice_groups), company_groups AS (SELECT g.Company, AVG(g.avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, SUM(g.line_count) AS total_line_count, AVG(1.0 * g.line_count / t.total_count) AS avg_share FROM invoice_groups AS g CROSS JOIN line_total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.Company) SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price), AVG(total_line_count), AVG(avg_share) FROM company_groups
